name: What should I ask before hiring a luxury material installer?

mainEntity.name: Which questions help verify that an installer can handle premium materials and high-end finishes correctly?
mainEntity.text: Which questions help verify that an installer can handle premium materials and high-end finishes correctly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring an installer for luxury fixtures or materials, ask specific questions about the exact products being used. Experience with marble, quartzite, large-format porcelain, brass fixtures, custom vanities, or specialty showers is more important than general remodeling experience. Ask who will do the work, whether the installer handles templating and fabrication coordination, and how they manage heavy materials and delicate finishes. It is also important to ask how they protect completed surfaces, what happens if a material arrives damaged, and how change orders are handled. A qualified installer should be able to explain the installation sequence, substrate requirements, sealing process, and maintenance expectations clearly. Homeowners should look for detailed answers, not vague promises, because luxury materials leave little room for correction once work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about experience with your exact material, how they handle templating and substrate prep, who performs the work, how they protect finished surfaces, and how they handle damage or changes. You should also confirm licensing, scheduling, warranty coverage, and cleanup responsibilities.
